title: Inner/nested evidence reference pins are not revalidated before package inventory refreshes their hashes
trigger: After a completed report has stored rawAttempt/stdout/stderr/probe or canonicalNestedCommands reference pins, an inner raw log/command/probe changes or goes missing while the completed report and outer attempt records remain unchanged.
observed: completed_context validates outer selected attempts, raw streams/probes, aggregate suite result and helpers. It never traverses result.innerEvidence or product canonicalNestedCommands. package_inventory freshly hashes the workflow files; its innerEvidence loop only pins probes under engine/_integration/evidence, not general inner rawAttempt/stdout/stderr/workflow probes.
impact: Exact package plan can embed stale provenance pins alongside newly hashed changed inner evidence; release full SHA would certify that contradictory inventory, not prove original completed evidence remained intact. No assertion that the actual canonical evidence is damaged; all reproduction files are private synthetic units.
requiredMinimalChange: Create a fresh revision; do not edit the sealed R1 tool root.
Add a read-only result-evidence validation helper invoked by completed_context before archive_tools or any plan write.

For every innerEvidence row pin rawAttempt, stdout, stderr and every probe at their recorded path/size/SHA; parse attempt, require exitCode=0/completed=true/product identity, compare raw hashes/decoder metadata and recipe argv/cwd/probe set; reject missing/extra/duplicate operation evidence against canonical command-recipes.

For product canonicalNestedCommands require exact expected sdk/product-build/launcher-build/same-entry-check-only membership and command/raw pins; validate names/exits/argv/cwd against pinned nested command plan. Keep explicit limitation that PowerShell grandchildren share parent streams.
Validate any further recorded PNG/JSON evidence references that the report relies on, with explicit allowed roots; do not replace reference hashes with current-file hashes to make drift pass.
Preserve failed evidence, no rerun of product/build/probe, refresh new tool-source/artifact seals and exact authority/root pins.
independentRetest: unchanged representative inner/nested records accepted as synthetic unit only
failed/partial/wrong identity/argv/cwd/extra or omitted inner operation rejected
nested command missing/duplicate/failed/mismatched raw pin rejected
all rejection occurs before archive/write; archive/inventory still covers validated inputs
